## Reviewed diagnostic summary

Use fixed error categories and a short description. Remove local paths, network
addresses/names, camera identifiers, pairing codes and credentials. Do not upload
raw logs, pairing files, catalog snapshots, databases or personal photos.

To include diagnostics, choose Help → Export diagnostic report… and review the preview before saving and sharing. A short description is enough if you prefer not to share a report.
